campus_notes: Michigan Housing explicitly does not publish per-room dimensions; their knowledge base (https://kb.housing.umich.edu/hc/en-us/articles/27512969150861-Residence-Hall-Room-Dimensions) says many doubles average 11' x 12' but individual rooms vary by era of construction. Beds take Twin XL (36" x 80") linens. Undergraduate rooms have one of two modular furniture systems (Building Block or Lifespace II) with published dimensions; both loft (58" clearance) or half-loft (28.5"), and Building Block also bunks/trundles. Custom-made lofts are prohibited. Furniture must sit at least 2 ft from windows and radiators. System-by-hall mapping: https://kb.housing.umich.edu/hc/en-us/articles/360002986491-Room-Furniture.
